decision: New acceptance boundary: existing two-writer regression uses threading.Thread. A thread-local mutex can make that test GREEN while independent Python worker processes still interleave archive read/dedup/append and three separate JSON replacements. Source has no process-shared transaction/lock. Require a separate subprocess (not threading-only) no-network test before claiming multi-process completeness; source-derived coverage gap, not confirmed production incident.
no_network_test_contract: At exact SHA spawn two independent Python subprocesses with a shared tmp_path and distinct fixed A/B as_of_ms. Phase 1: empty archive; pause process A after latest.json write, start B, capture baseline overtaking/mixed generations; always release A in finally and collect exit codes/stderr. Phase 2 after Gemini repair: phase-aware synchronization permits B to block behind A; release A, require both exit 0, final latest/audit/anata generation all B. Separately feed one identical external JSONL observation to both processes and require exactly one archived observation with preserved provenance and combined appended count 1. Do not deadlock by requiring both processes to enter a barrier held inside the repaired lock. No network. Commands: python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py ; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests.
